_comment: Fixture: Phase 3D research-workflow fields. Expected outcomes — Row 1 Research Garden Cafe: potential_new, ZERO issues (place-anchored maps URL, cuisine/menu, rating+count+source+check date, per-field sources). Row 2 Search Url Cafes: insufficient_evidence (a maps SEARCH url is not an identity anchor) with warning MAPS_URL_IS_SEARCH_NOT_LISTING. Row 3 Menu Rich Kitchen: insufficient_evidence — cuisine/menu notes are descriptive, not identity. Row 4 Count No Source Cafe: potential_new with warnings LISTING_REVIEW_COUNT_WITHOUT_SOURCE + RATING_WITHOUT_CHECK_DATE. Row 5 Ayyappa Tiffin Room: existing_match, zero issues — review_decision=same_as_existing with a real existing_match_id. Row 6 Wrong Id Diner: insufficient_evidence with warning EXISTING_MATCH_ID_NOT_IN_BASELINE (valid uuid, absent from baseline). Row 7 Bad Decision Bistro: invalid_data via INVALID_REVIEW_DECISION. Row 8 Foreign Directory House: invalid_data via INVALID_MAPS_LISTING_URL (non-Google URL in maps_listing_url). Row 9 Amigos: existing_match with flag REVIEW_DECISION_CONFLICTS_WITH_MATCH (distinct_new_business contradicts a strong tool match — human must resolve).
